title: studio template
description: A template package is data, not code (docs/architecture.md §5, 'Templates'): template.json plus PNG assets in the NES palette. The engine draws any package that validates against this schema.

image_style.description: The template's own look for generated scene pictures (time of day, dominant colors), added to the channel's style in every scene prompt (studio/scene_images.py).

license_note.description: Where the template's own assets come from and under what license; required whenever assets[] is non-empty.

studio.description: The anchor desk: background layers, the layers in front of the anchor (the desk), and where the anchor (any of the channel's anchors: they share one canvas) and the screen behind the anchor sit.

parallax.description: 0 = fixed background, 1 = moves at full foreground speed

front.description: Drawn over the anchor (the desk in front of them); must not cover any anchor's face.

scale.description: Integer multiple only (no fractional resize): keeps every anchor sprite pixel an exact whole number of frame pixels wide, so it stays aligned with the engine's NES pixel grid.

screen.description: The screen behind the anchor that shows a picture during anchor shots (the anchor scene's own, else the next scene shot's); its shape sets the screen picture's aspect.

border_color.description: A 2-px frame around the picture; none when absent.

colors.description: Subset of channels/8bitnews-us/palette.json this template draws from.

serious_colors.description: Muted subset (night, greys and blues) used when the script's serious_mode is true.

scene_colors.description: What scene pictures snap to in normal mode; when absent they keep the generator's own colors (fitted to the 270x480 grid). The template's own colors stay for what it draws itself.

plates.description: The text format.md requires in frame, each confined to a safe zone: the AI line, and the source and title plates (centered, as wide as their text).

ai_label.description: One line centered in the frame, no plate behind it: 'AI voice', joined by 'AI illustration' while a real person is in frame.

sound.description: Relative path to the transition's sound (a short PCM wav under assets/, with its license in <file>.license.txt next to it), or null for none. Never played in serious mode.

timing.description: Timing knobs that depend on the template, not the channel (E2a-2a: studio build).

scene_pause_s.description: Silence between consecutive scenes when the Timeline is built from real voice timings; no pause before the first or after the last scene.

assets.description: Relative paths (under assets/) to every PNG/sound file the template references; validated to exist, be in-palette, and free of external URLs.

bg_color.description: A plate behind the lines, as wide as the longest; without it the text is outlined.

font_scale.description: Glyph size in whole multiples of the channel font; max_chars_per_line counts at this size. A cue with a longer word drops to scale 1.

max_lines.description: Lines of scene text the plate holds (scene_title, source_plate). The rect must be at least 10*max_lines+2 px high; studio build fails on text that needs more lines.

below.description: Sit under that plate when it is shown, else at the rect's own top.
